name: get-fable
description: Fable 5 Mythos-Tier Agent Upgrade — Installs Claude Fable 5 System Prompt, Fable Mode Discipline, & Mechanical Hooks across Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and AI Coding Agents.

scripts.build: bun build ./src/cli.ts --outfile ./bin/get-fable.js --target bun && echo '#!/usr/bin/env bun' | cat - bin/get-fable.js > bin/get-fable.js.tmp && mv bin/get-fable.js.tmp bin/get-fable.js && chmod +x bin/get-fable.js

author: Mamdouh Abo Ammar
